So when processing `description`, `prev_field` = `employeeinfo` (a OneToOneRel), and `prev_field.remote_field` = the OneToOneField `employee` on EmployeeInfo. That field has no `parent_link` attribute directly.

So I need to use `getattr(prev_field.remote_field, "parent_link", False)`. Let me apply that.
